subject: ent
title: External nose, nasal septum and choanal atresia

steps.tx: The external nose is skin over upper lateral, lower lateral (alar) cartilages and nasal bones, vulnerable to trauma and sun cancers. Inside, the **septum** (quadrilateral cartilage, perpendicular plate, vomer) divides airflow; deviations are near universal but matter when they obstruct, cause contact headache points or block sinus surgery access. Little area on the anterior septum hosts Kiesselbach plexus.
steps.say: Most septums deviate slightly. Trouble starts when deviation blocks airflow, sinuses or surgery. Front septum vessels bleed easily.

steps.tx: Nasal fractures are clinical diagnoses (deformity, swelling, epistaxis, septal haematoma) needing assessment within hours for haematoma and after swelling settles (about a week) for closed reduction window (roughly two weeks adults). **Septal haematoma** must be drained urgently: blood strips cartilage of perichondrial nutrition causing necrosis, saddle nose and abscess risk, especially in children.
steps.say: Drain septal blood urgently or cartilage dies and nose saddles. Broken noses reduce best after swelling falls, within two weeks.

steps.tx: **Key point.** Septal perforations follow surgery, trauma, nose picking, cocaine or granulomatous disease (granulomatosis with polyangiitis), presenting with crusting, whistling and epistaxis. Small symptomatic holes get humidification and obturators; surgery closes selected larger ones. Cocaine and vasculitis must stop or be treated before repair attempts.
steps.say: Septal holes whistle and crust. Cocaine and vasculitis cause them and must be controlled before any closure works.

steps.tx: **Choanal atresia** blocks the posterior nasal airway by bony or membranous plate: bilateral disease distresses neonates (obligate nose breathers) with cyclical cyanosis relieved by crying, failing nasogastric tube passage, while unilateral disease presents later with one sided discharge. CHARGE association links choanal atresia with coloboma, heart, growth and ear anomalies. Endoscopic perforation and stenting opens the airway.
steps.say: Newborn blue when quiet, pink when crying, tube will not pass: bilateral choanal atresia. Open it endoscopically.

steps.tx: **Key point.** Septoplasty straightens obstructing septum preserving cartilage support (L strut) to avoid saddle; submucosal resection is largely historical for deforming support. Rhinoplasty reshapes external framework for form and function combined. Postoperative packs, splints and saline irrigation support healing; septal perforation and saddle are counselled risks.
steps.say: Modern septoplasty preserves support struts to prevent saddling while straightening the airway.
